courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 自行式模組運輸車換橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統」與「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；自行式模組運輸車換橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules" and "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of SPMT bridge replacement must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以角柱荷載路徑、模組間繫結、吊具設計與堆疊公差控制，讓工廠製造的體積模組安全成為整體建築；自行式模組運輸車換橋則以以支承點改變、軸線容量、地盤承載與封閉時段控制，用自行式模組運輸車在數小時內移除舊橋並放上整跨新橋為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on corner-post load paths, inter-module ties, lifting-gear design and stacking-tolerance control that turn factory-made volumetric modules safely into one building; SPMT bridge replacement centres on support-point changes, axle-line capacity, ground bearing and closure-window control that let SPMTs remove an old span and set a whole new one within hours, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「角柱與雙層樓板」與「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到自行式模組運輸車換橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「運輸過程的即時監測與停止條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Corner posts and double floors” and “SPMT support points and overhangs”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to SPMT bridge replacement, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Real-time monitoring and stop criteria during the move", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 預鑄混凝土耐震接頭
related.transfer: 可遷移「體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統」與「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules" and "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seismic connections for precast concrete must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以角柱荷載路徑、模組間繫結、吊具設計與堆疊公差控制，讓工廠製造的體積模組安全成為整體建築；預鑄混凝土耐震接頭則以以等同現澆與接合式兩種策略、混合預力接頭、套筒續接與支承長度，讓預鑄構架在地震中可靠傳力並能自行復位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on corner-post load paths, inter-module ties, lifting-gear design and stacking-tolerance control that turn factory-made volumetric modules safely into one building; Seismic connections for precast concrete centres on emulative and jointed strategies, hybrid post-tensioned joints, grouted sleeves and seating length that let precast frames transfer seismic force reliably and recentre, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「角柱與雙層樓板」與「樓板隔板接合器」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到預鑄混凝土耐震接頭，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Corner posts and double floors” and “Diaphragm connectors”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic connections for precast concrete, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 建築模組化吊裝與接合
history.text: 以工廠預製構件組成建築的想法由來已久，英國 1957 年成立的 CLASP 以預製系統大量興建學校；1967 年蒙特婁世界博覽會的 Habitat 67 由 Moshe Safdie 設計，以 354 個預製混凝土箱體堆疊成住宅群，成為體積模組的代表作。2010 年代模組建築往高層發展：紐約 461 Dean Street 於 2012 年動工、2016 年以 32 層開幕，當時被稱為世界最高的模組公寓；新加坡自 2014 年起要求部分政府售地住宅採用 PPVC，The Clement Canopy 以兩棟 40 層塔樓、1,866 個混凝土模組完成。2021 年 ICC 與模組建築協會發布 1200 與 1205 兩項異地建造標準。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The idea of assembling buildings from factory-made parts is old: CLASP, formed in England in 1957, built many schools from a prefabricated system, and Habitat 67, designed by Moshe Safdie for the 1967 Montreal Expo, stacked 354 precast concrete boxes into housing and became the emblem of volumetric construction. In the 2010s modular building went high-rise: 461 Dean Street in New York broke ground in 2012 and opened in 2016 at 32 storeys, billed at the time as the world's tallest modular apartment building, and Singapore required PPVC on selected Government Land Sales housing sites from 2014, with The Clement Canopy completed as two 40-storey towers from 1,866 concrete modules. In 2021 the ICC and the Modular Building Institute issued the off-site construction standards 1200 and 1205. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

roles.businessEn: Singapore's building authority, which mandates PPVC on selected sites and runs the manufacturer accreditation scheme.

roles.role: 異地建造的設計、製造與檢查標準架構

roles.business: 美國建築規範制定組織，與模組建築協會共同發布異地建造標準。
roles.businessEn: US building-code developer that issued off-site construction standards with the Modular Building Institute.

courses.connection: 從「建築模組化吊裝與接合」的材料、構件、施工或監測延伸到下列公司、業主與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購或背書。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies, owners and institutions related to the materials, members, construction or monitoring of Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement or endorsement.
